coding.consoleEmpty: Press Compile or Simulation to see what the elevator does.
coding.saveNeedsName: Enter a program name before saving.
coding.saveDuplicateName: A program with that name already exists. Choose another name or load it to update it.

parseErrors.MISSING_START: The program must start with command {{start}} (start elevator).
parseErrors.MISSING_END: The program must end with command {{end}} (end elevator).
parseErrors.INVALID_START_COMMAND: Command {{start}} must be only the letter {{start}} (uppercase or lowercase), with no numbers or extra text (line {{line}}{{suffix}}).
parseErrors.INVALID_END_COMMAND: Command {{end}} must be only the letter {{end}} (uppercase or lowercase), with no numbers or extra text (line {{line}}{{suffix}}).
parseErrors.INVALID_START_PLACEMENT: Command {{start}} (start) can only be on the first line of the program (line {{line}}{{suffix}}).
parseErrors.INVALID_END_PLACEMENT: Command {{end}} (end) can only be on the last line of the program (line {{line}}{{suffix}}).
parseErrors.MISSING_BODY_COMMANDS: There must be at least one command between {{start}} (start) and {{end}} (end) (line {{line}}{{suffix}}).
parseErrors.INVALID_LEVEL: Invalid level on line {{line}}{{suffix}}. Use a number from 1 to 6 for {{up}} or {{down}}.
parseErrors.INVALID_CHANNEL: Invalid channel on line {{line}}{{suffix}}. Use a number from 1 to 9 for {{stop}} or {{open}}.
parseErrors.MISSING_NEWLINE: Missing newline after the command on line {{line}}{{suffix}}.
parseErrors.MULTIPLE_START: There can only be one {{start}} (start) command in the program (line {{line}}{{suffix}}).
parseErrors.UNEXPECTED_AFTER_END: There is content after the {{end}} (end) command on line {{line}}{{suffix}}.
parseErrors.FLOOR_ABOVE_MAX: Cannot go up further: the elevator cannot go above floor {{maxFloor}} (line {{line}}{{suffix}}).
parseErrors.FLOOR_BELOW_MIN: Cannot go down further: the elevator cannot go below floor {{minFloor}} (line {{line}}{{suffix}}).
